svg.title: Observed GDP per capita at 1960, 1990, 2020: six paths on one shared axis
svg.desc: A six-panel dashboard. Each panel plots the frozen World Development Indicators GDP-per-capita observations in constant 2015 US dollars at three anchor years for one country. All six panels share a 0 to 35,000 US dollar vertical axis and the same 1960, 1990, 2020 horizontal positions. Row 1 (Africa) shows Ghana (terracotta circles, 1101; 856; 1970), Botswana (green squares, 394; 4039; 6254) and Mauritius (ochre triangles with charcoal keyline, 1419; 3846; 9534). Row 2 (Asia) shows South Korea (blue diamonds with long-dashed connector, 1038; 9673; 33216), Malaysia (jade hexagons, 1266; 4185; 10171) and the Philippines (red cross with charcoal under-stroke, 1124; 1704; 3199). Malaysia 1960 is a retrospective territorial series across the 1963 formation of Malaysia; 2020 is the COVID-19 year for all six countries. Straight connectors join observed anchors only. The chart cannot establish whether culture, policy, institutions, war, aid, or another factor caused the gaps, and it is not a uniform Africa-versus-Asia race.
svg.metadata: Chart ID: VIS-006-GDP-A4. Frozen full-precision observations (NY.GDP.PCAP.KD, constant 2015 US dollars per person): Ghana: 1960=1100.76305218242; 1990=855.85250708181; 2020=1970.19411460398. Botswana: 1960=393.861742487166; 1990=4039.46544455099; 2020=6254.24806241091. Mauritius: 1960=1419.4048237128; 1990=3846.40593009531; 2020=9533.5982796049. South Korea: 1960=1037.72899231615; 1990=9672.57845182894; 2020=33215.9298928108. Malaysia: 1960=1266.31525712689; 1990=4184.76072928976; 2020=10171.4657842762. Philippines: 1960=1123.78209980486; 1990=1704.07568899121; 2020=3198.66690008413. Geometry: viewBox 1600x1100. Row 1 plot y range 220..550; Row 2 plot y range 620..950. Plot height per row = 330 units. Shared domain 0..35000 constant 2015 US dollars. y = y_baseline - value * 33 / 3500 where y_baseline is 550 (Row 1) or 950 (Row 2). Panel x positions: Panel 1 x=206, 376, 546. Panel 2 x=686, 856, 1026. Panel 3 x=1166, 1336, 1506. Year positions correspond to 1960, 1990, 2020 within every panel. Source: SRC-WDI-001; World Bank (2026), World Development Indicators; indicator NY.GDP.PCAP.KD; WDI API v2 source 2; release 2026-07-13; retrieved 2026-10-06; https://databank.worldbank.org/source/world-development-indicators. Frozen data: data/charts/six_country_gdp_anchor_years.csv. Specification: design/figures/SIX_COUNTRY_GDP_ANCHOR_SPEC.md.

g.text: GDP per capita at three anchors.
Constant 2015 US$ per person · Africa top row, Asia below · one shared scale · no causal claim

g.aria-label: Row 1 shared axis: 0 to 35,000 constant 2015 US dollars
Row 2 shared axis: 0 to 35,000 constant 2015 US dollars
Malaysia: 1,266 in 1960; 4,185 in 1990; 10,171 in 2020. 1960 is a retrospective territorial series.

g.text: Lines link only the three dated observations.
No values between years are shown or estimated.
† Malaysia 1960 is a retrospective territorial series
predating the 1963 formation and Singapore’s 1965 exit; 2020 is the COVID-19 year.
Gaps do not identify culture, policy, institutions,
war, aid, or another cause. Not a race.
Note. GDP per capita, constant 2015 US$. WDI NY.GDP.PCAP.KD · World Bank (2026) · SRC-WDI-001 · release 2026-07-13 · frozen CSV: data/charts/six_country_gdp_anchor_years.csv.
